property.name: mapreduce.framework.name
property.description: Execution framework for MapReduce. Must be 'yarn' for Hadoop 3.x

property.name: mapreduce.application.classpath
property.description: Classpath for MapReduce applications. Adjust $HADOOP_HOME to your actual Hadoop installation path.

property.name: yarn.app.mapreduce.am.resource.mb
property.description:
Memory for the MapReduce ApplicationMaster.
For 4GB VM: 512 MB For 8GB VM: 1024 MB
ApplicationMaster coordinates the MapReduce job.

property.name: yarn.app.mapreduce.am.command-opts
property.description: JVM options for ApplicationMaster. Should be ~80% of yarn.app.mapreduce.am.resource.mb

property.name: mapreduce.map.memory.mb
property.description:
Memory allocation for Map tasks.
For 4GB VM: 512 MB For 8GB VM: 1024 MB
Adjust based on your data size and available memory.

property.name: mapreduce.map.java.opts
property.description: JVM heap size for Map tasks. Should be ~80% of mapreduce.map.memory.mb

property.name: mapreduce.reduce.memory.mb
property.description:
Memory allocation for Reduce tasks.
For 4GB VM: 512 MB For 8GB VM: 1024 MB
Typically same as or 2x map memory due to sort/merge operations.

property.name: mapreduce.reduce.java.opts
property.description: JVM heap size for Reduce tasks. Should be ~80% of mapreduce.reduce.memory.mb

property.name: mapreduce.map.output.compress
property.description: Compress map output to reduce network I/O during shuffle. Highly recommended for better performance.

property.name: mapreduce.map.output.compress.codec
property.description: Compression codec for map output. Snappy: Fast compression/decompression (recommended) LZ4: Even faster but less compression GZip: Better compression but slower

property.name: mapreduce.task.io.sort.mb
property.description: Memory buffer for sorting map output. Larger values improve performance but use more memory. Should be less than Map task memory.

property.name: mapreduce.task.io.sort.factor
property.description: Number of streams to merge at once during sorting. Higher values = fewer merge passes = better performance But also more file handles open at once.

property.name: mapreduce.reduce.shuffle.parallelcopies
property.description: Number of parallel transfers during shuffle. Higher values improve shuffle performance.

property.name: mapreduce.jobhistory.address
property.description: MapReduce Job History Server IPC address. Optional - only if you run History Server separately.

property.name: mapreduce.jobhistory.webapp.address
property.description: MapReduce Job History Server web UI address. Optional - only if you run History Server separately.

property.name: mapreduce.map.speculative
property.description: Enable speculative execution for map tasks. Runs duplicate tasks if some are slow. Disable for small clusters to save resources.

property.name: mapreduce.reduce.speculative
property.description: Enable speculative execution for reduce tasks. Usually disabled as reduces are harder to speculate.
